title: Well and Winter
author: Lena Quintana
blurb: Jude Nakamura, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
